about: 9 V at the DC jack J1 (centre negative); the footswitch on (throw a: the boost and its LED) or in bypass (throw b). The volume at half. Values with 'note' are assumptions.

J1.note: a 9 V pedal supply, centre negative, behind its plug and lead: 1 Ω source resistance (assumed)

bypass.about: the footswitch in bypass: input jack to output jack

boost.about: from the boost's input pad In to the collector, a pickup in front (information: no source states the gain the design intends; the bounds are the test's – an unbypassed emitter gives about R3 / R4 = 10 kΩ / 390 Ω, 28 dB, less the emitter's own resistance at its 0.5 mA and the volume's load on the collector)

source.note: the test's values for a single-coil pickup with its cable, not a product's (FT-18 brings the makers' figures)
